title: Wonderlane curriculum depth and activity expansion
status: 40 activities in every section implemented; educator and audio review pending

userDirection.gradeRule: Every launch, resume, review and visible grade label must agree with the selected subject grade. No automatic promotion to another grade.
userDirection.audioCue: Theo points at Hear directions on first use of a game. Tap here to hear what to do. Dismiss after activation; keep written directions and replay available.
userDirection.workedExampleVoice: Pressing Play must start Theo narration and the demonstration together. The explanation must match the actual example word or math model.

definitions.section: A broad learning area such as addition and subtraction
definitions.unit: A sequenced skill cluster with explicit prerequisites
definitions.activity: A distinct learning task or scenario, not merely another seed for the same question
definitions.question: A fresh validated example inside an activity

planningTargets.note: Targets include expanded existing content. Grade-specific scope and educator review determine final counts; grade 3 sound work is differentiated and foundational remediation is clearly marked.

currentAudit.verified: 1,320 activities across 33 grade/subject sections; 40 per section. 78 original passages plus four Grade 1 little books.
gradeIssues: Changing grade does not reset an already open lesson
Home continuation can pick lastSkill from the earlier grade
Header uses mathGrade while parent settings permit a different readingGrade
contentIssues: Sequence activities use sequence as a passage field while stories store first, producing undefined answer text in r1-26, r2-25 and r3-25
Several named topics share a question mechanic without teaching all of the named skill
Phonics currently emphasizes whole-word recognition/spelling rather than a full sound-to-text progression
Passages are grade-tagged but lack taught-pattern decodability metadata
Fluency is practice and is not measured oral reading

Remotion Play currently runs a visual demonstration while Hear the example is a separate control; children can miss the explanation. The generic teaching caption can discuss cap/cape while the example asks about cube.
currentAudit.requiredTestImprovement: Validate educational content and named objectives, grade ranges, valid story fields, and representation-to-skill agreement beyond selectable-answer structure.

gameplayAndMotion.hyperframes: brief Theo arrivals, world transitions and restrained completion moments
gameplayAndMotion.remotion: replayable narrated worked examples showing a mathematical or reading concept
gameplayAndMotion.interactive3D: child actions that create, exchange, partition, measure or share real model quantities
gameplayAndMotion.reward: earn pieces for a persistent workshop or garden after learning tasks, with natural stopping points
gameplayAndMotion.accessibility: stable answer layouts, reduced motion, touch and keyboard alternatives, written text, speaker replay

voice.narration: ElevenLabs for reviewed Theo directions and whole-word/text narration when configured
voice.phonemes: separately reviewed sound clips; do not assume general TTS pronounces isolated phonemes correctly
voice.fluencyAssessment: optional future parent-enabled feature requiring separate validation; do not infer oral fluency from multiple-choice answers

workedExample.controls: Unified play, pause, stop and replay behavior; prevent overlapping speech.
workedExample.timing: Set the demonstration duration from reviewed narration; do not assume the current eight-second visual duration is sufficient.
workedExample.example: For cube, use the curated pair cub to cube, emphasize the u, and explain the final silent e. Show the spelling letters without presenting silent e as a separate spoken phoneme.
workedExample.scaffolding: Give one short instruction at a time, optional extra explanation, slower replay and a fresh independent task after modeling.
workedExample.assessment: Directions and the spoken target of a spelling task are normal task input. Narrating the passage being independently decoded, revealing a solution or using a hint must be recorded as supported work.
workedExample.fallback: Use the browser voice for early implementation, then validate the configured ElevenLabs voice and isolated sound clips.
acceptance: Play produces audible narration after user activation
narration and visuals refer to the same example
all spoken explanation fits before completion
pause or navigation stops old speech
replay does not overlap other speech
captions remain readable with audio off
fresh independent examples do not receive modeled answers
